TWISTPRSAT THEOREM CHALLENGES

Each numbered file below is separately loadable in TwistPrSAT.  It states the
negation of a theorem or proposition from the paper.  Select SMT (Z3), load one
file from the `theorems` folder, and press Find Model.  The expected result is
UNSAT: no probability model is a counterexample to the stated result.

01_reliable_contradiction_unsat.txt
  Proposition 4(3): p(A & ~A & oA) = 0.
  Challenge: Pr(A & ~A & oA) > 0

02_reliability_bound_unsat.txt
  Proposition 4(4): p(oA) <= p(A v ~A).
  Challenge: Pr(oA) > Pr(A v ~A)

03_classical_negation_complement_unsat.txt
  Proposition 4(7): p(cnot A) = 1 - p(A).
  Challenge: Pr(cnot A) != 1 - Pr(A)

04_inclusion_exclusion_unsat.txt
  Definition 10, Ax1.4: p(A)+p(B) = p(A & B)+p(A v B).
  Challenge: Pr(A) + Pr(B) != Pr(A & B) + Pr(A v B)

05_positive_region_decomposition_unsat.txt
  Corollary 3 / the P1-to-P6 translation: positive mass is B° plus B
  plus C.
  Challenge: Pr(A) != Pr(A & oA) + Pr(A & cnot (~A v oA)) + Pr(A & ~A)

06_negative_region_decomposition_unsat.txt
  Corollary 3 / the P1-to-P6 translation: negative mass is D° plus D
  plus C.
  Challenge: Pr(~A) != Pr(~A & oA) + Pr(~A & cnot (A v oA)) + Pr(A & ~A)

07_reliability_region_decomposition_unsat.txt
  Corollary 2: reliability mass is B° plus D°.
  Challenge: Pr(oA) != Pr(A & oA) + Pr(~A & oA)

08_six_region_partition_unsat.txt
  Definition 12, Ax6.3 / Proposition 2: the six region probabilities sum to 1.
  Challenge: the displayed six-term sum is not 1.

09_entailment_identity_unsat.txt
  Proposition 4(8): if psi entails phi, then p(phi & psi)=p(psi).
  Here psi is A & B and phi is A.
  Challenge: Pr(A & (A & B)) != Pr(A & B)

10_classical_difference_identity_unsat.txt
  Proposition 4(9): p(phi & cnot psi)=p(phi)-p(phi & psi).
  Challenge: Pr(A & cnot B) != Pr(A) - Pr(A & B)
